description: Record on YOUR setlist.fm account that you attended a show — the site's "I was there" marker — by setlist ID. Authenticated via your session (needs SETLIST_SESSION_COOKIE). Idempotent: a no-op if already marked. Reversible with setlist_unmark_attended. Toggles attendance and verifies by re-reading your attended list. Results include a setlist.fm `url`; when you present this data, cite it as a clickable source link to setlist.fm (their API terms require followable attribution — no nofollow). If a result has no `url`, link to https://www.setlist.fm instead.
name: setlist_mark_attended
